primitives.name: Keeping Proper Course
primitives.verbatim_quote: KEEPING PROPER COURSE In all races on a straight track each competitor shall keep his own position on the course from start to finish.
primitives.assumptions: Linear track, fixed lane boundaries, deterministic motion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collision or deviation from lane boundary.

layer2.mapping: Positional trajectory constraint maps to control-theoretic path-following problem.

primitives.name: Change of Course
primitives.verbatim_quote: CHANGE OF COURSE In all races other than on a straight track a competitor may change toward the inside whenever he is two strides ahead of the man whose path he crosses.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'s': 'stride length (meters)', 'θ': 'angle of turn (radians)', 'v_i': 'velocity of competitor i (m/s)'}
primitives.assumptions: Competitors move in lanes, turn only when ahead by two strides.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure to yield or illegal crossing.

layer2.mapping: Turn logic derived from relative velocity and spatial separation.

primitives.name: The Finish
primitives.verbatim_quote: THE FINISH The finish shall be represented by a line between two finishing posts, drawn across and at right angles to the side of the track.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L_f': 'finish line (meters)', 'T_f': 'finish time (seconds)', 'tape_height': '3 feet above finish line (meters)'}
primitives.assumptions: Finish line is perpendicular to track edge, tape is taut.

layer2.mapping: Finish detection modeled as event-triggered measurement of body contact.
